### 🔗 http://maker:4001 (refresh)

**Action A — Clearer scope + tag suggestions**
1. Select two links; the bar's button now reads **"Select all N matching"** (its scope is the whole current view/search/tag set, not just a visible page).
2. In the **add tag** box type a few letters of a tag you've used — your existing tags appear as suggestions; click one to apply it to everyone selected.

**Action B — Selection that clears itself sensibly**
1. Go to **To read**, select a couple, and click **Mark read**. They leave the To read view, and because they're no longer in front of you, **the selection clears** — no invisible leftovers.
2. Now in **All**, select one and **add a tag**. It stays visible, so **the selection stays** — you can keep acting on it.
3. Filter to that tag, select the link, and **remove** the tag via the menu. It drops out of the filtered view, so the **selection clears** again.

---

This settles bulk management: "Select all N matching" for the whole set, existing-tag suggestions when bulk-tagging, the remove-tag menu, delete confined to the archive with confirmation, and a selection that keeps what stays visible and clears what leaves.

Does this match your intent? If yes, I'll lock it in and move to the next area — **saved views** (a reusable view built from search words plus tags to include or exclude).
